newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Kellogg EPS views lowered.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Kellogg EPS views lowered.

text.p: -- BT Securities analyst John O'Neil said in a research note that he lowered his 1996 earnings estimate for Kellogg Co to $3.10 per share from $3.30 and the 1997 estimate to $3.60 per share from $3.70.
-- The shares are still rated a market performer, he said.

-- "Currently, we believe Kellogg's valuation doesn't fully discount a potentially lengthy period of adverse category fundamentals -- weak margins and volumes. We note that the pet food category endured margin erosion for several years and the spice category already is more than a year into its deflation, so we see no reason to believe cereal is a one-quarter phenomenon," according to the analyst.
-- Further, "we do not expect category volumes to rebound due to price alone since promotions remain the primary category driver. We see downside in Kellogg shares to the low $60 range."
